en: A black and white postcard featuring four separate photographs of different landmarks in Riesa, a town on the Elbe river. The images include Stadtpark (city park) with a central staircase, Leninplatz (Lenin Square) showing open urban squares and historical buildings, Rathaus u. Kirche (town hall and church) with picturesque traditional German architecture and church steeple, and a Dampferanlegeplatz (steamboat landing stage) by the river with a boat docked.
